lines: Suppose hearts and love had a shape
I wish I could see you as you are
Before this yearning melts away
Let's go search for the footprints in the starry sky
In the world I touched with you
I scream that I still don't want to disappear like this
A steady heartbeat now pours between us
The fingertips that bind will surely not let go
There is a past and regret that no one can reclaim
Unsolvable pain is probably the proof of being human
Shining brightly
Like a scattered shooting star
The voices that merge into one and overlap
Will keep reaching endlessly
Holding cold tears
Laments that I no longer want to be alone
Right beside you
Let's promise to breathe together
In the world I touched with you
I scream that I still don't want to disappear like this
A steady heartbeat now pours between us
I want to live together in any future
Because the shining starry sky is so beautiful
